# DialogBox { #anylumino.DialogBox }

```python
DialogBox(
    children=None,
    *,
    title='',
    open=False,
    width=420,
    callbacks=None,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Display a composable modal dialog.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type     | Description                                                            | Default   |
|-----------|----------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| children  | optional | Child anywidgets or keyed child mapping rendered inside the component. | `None`    |
| title     | optional | Dialog title text.                                                     | `''`      |
| open      | optional | Whether an overlay-like component starts open.                         | `False`   |
| width     | optional | CSS width for display-oriented components.                             | `420`     |
| callbacks | optional | Optional callbacks invoked when the widget sends an activation event.  | `None`    |
